The `agy-skins` WebWallGL renderer lifecycle, `we-picker` gallery and tab UI
architecture, two-stage readability Liquid Glass palette, rotation playlist
model, typography matrix, cursor FX, and 3D parallax modules are adapted from
this project natively for Google Antigravity without pets, mascots, or avatars.

Wallpaper Engine workshop assets are not redistributed.
